description:
Five9 is a leader in AI-powered cloud contact center software, serving thousands of customers around the world and powering billions of customer interactions every year. We help enterprises deliver smarter customer experience with every interaction, turning every customer conversation into an opportunity to build trust, deepen loyalty, and drive growth. Our Genius CX platform combines deep contact center expertise with applied AI to deliver outcomes the business can measure.

Our team-first culture enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.

Five9 is looking for a UK & Ireland Field Marketing Manager (12-Month Fixed Term Contract) to lead high-impact events that generate qualified opportunities and accelerate pipeline growth across the UK and Ireland.

Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Business Development, and strategic partners, you will own the regional events calendar and deliver compelling experiences that connect Five9 with key decision-makers. This is a hands-on, “can-do”, commercially focused role combining creative thinking with exceptional organisational and execution skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Event Strategy & Planning: Own the UK and Ireland events calendar, aligned to sales priorities, target accounts and pipeline goals.
  • Event Execution: Deliver flagship conferences, trade shows, executive roundtables, VIP dinners, Hospitality events and customer events end to end.
  • Pipeline Generation: Generate qualified meetings, leads and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs) through targeted event programmes.
  • Sales Engagement: Partner with Sales and Business Development on pre-event outreach, onsite engagement and post-event conversion.
  • Partner Collaboration: Deliver joint events with strategic partners to attract prospects and expand market reach.
  • Event Experience: Create distinctive, engaging experiences that connect with senior decision-makers.
  • Giveaways & Merchandise: Manage branded giveaways and customer gifts across the UK and Ireland, including sourcing, budgets, inventory and distribution, to support prospect engagement, customer relationships and events.
  • Performance & ROI: Manage budgets, agencies and suppliers; measure event results and optimise investment based on pipeline impact.

Experience & Skills

  • Experience - 10+ years’ experience in UKI B2B field or event marketing, ideally in SaaS or enterprise technology.
  • Proven success delivering events that generate qualified pipeline and measurable business results.
  • UK&I Event types - strong experience with conferences, trade shows, executive roundtables and VIP events.
  • Technology Experience - Hands-on proficiency in Marketo, Looker, Outreach, Zuddl, Canva and Salesforce for event marketing, engagement, content and reporting.
  • Project Management - Proficiency in Monday.com for project plans, timelines, budgets and cross-functional coordination.
  • Skills for the role - Excellent project management, supplier management and stakeholder collaboration skills.
  • Personal Skills: Creative, proactive and highly organised, with strong attention to detail and commercial focus.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel across the UK and Ireland;

In-market Experience is an advantage - contact centre, customer experience, AI or cloud technology.

12-Month Fixed Term Contract (Maternity Cover)

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.  

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.
